title: Evaluation of a singleton tensor Čech coface
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F a quasi-coherent X-module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], U and W étale X-objects, g:W→U, n a natural number and j∈Fin(n+2). For any degree-n section s of the singleton tensor-section Čech complex [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization], evaluation at the unique outer tuple of δ_j(s) equals restriction along the product map omitting j of the unique outer evaluation of s. Here the products have n+1 and n+2 copies of W over U, evaluation is categorical product projection at the constant-zero tuple followed by ULift.down, and the product map is Pi.lift of the j.succAbove projections. No tensor, comparison map or normalization hypothesis is involved.

source.place: Tag 03P2, Theorem 59.22.4, affine singleton Čech/Amitsur identification; Tag 03DR, equation 35.8.0.1

proof.text: Apply singletonTensorCech_coface_raw_projection, then apply congrArg ULift.down. Compose the resulting equality with singletonTensorCech_coface_map_down. The two source projections and the displayed target projection agree definitionally with the lifted tensor-section groups.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03P2 and 03DR; compose the proved raw coface projection equation after ULift.down with the now proved map-down equation. Both component declarations have complete proofs.

mathlib_searches.results: Projection calculation lemmas only; not the geometric coface evaluation.

No existing declaration of these statements. Existing normalization-evaluation gives existence of a normalized additive evaluation, not coface evaluation or its restriction identity. EtaleTensorSections provides the semilinearity and composition tools.

theorem singletonTensorCech_coface_evaluation
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2))
    (s : (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n) :
    ((Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) → Fin 1 ↦
      AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
        Γ((Modules.tensorPullback
          (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) ↦ Over.mk g)).left.hom).obj F, ⊤)))
      (fun _ ↦ 0)) ((singletonTensorCechCosimplicial X F U W g).δ j s)).down =
    Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F (Pi.lift (fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) ↦ Over.mk g) (j.succAbove k))).left
      (((Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 1 ↦
      AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
        Γ((Modules.tensorPullback
          (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)).left.hom).obj F, ⊤)))
      (fun _ ↦ 0)) s).down)
